_source: Server-side meowfficer battle EXP (SC_40004 commander_exp), in no client table or Lua: the client only adds what the server sends (FinishStageCommand.GenerateCommanderExp). From the BWIKI's datamined formula (wiki.biligame.com/blhx/公式合集, 指挥喵经验公式): per ship ship_types + rarities + its star; per battle floor(sum over the fleet's ships x enemy_rates) + the map's bonus, the same for the command and the support cat. Checked against the page's example (3 rainbow CAs + 3 rainbow BBs in a chapter 12 normal battle: 28). No capture has a meowfficer in a sortie.

ship_types._source: by ship_data_statistics type (ShipType). The wiki's 舰种补正: DD 0; CL / BM / AR / SS 1; CA / CVL 2; CV 3; BC 4; BB 5. CB (18) as a CA: the page's example counts 超巡 as 重巡. Types the page doesn't list (BBV, SSV, AE, DDG, IX...) count 0

rarities._source: by ship_data_statistics rarity (the config's, before a retrofit): the wiki's 稀有度补正, white 0, blue 1, purple 2, gold 3, rainbow 4

enemy_rates._source: the wiki's 道中boss补正: 0.3 for a normal enemy, 0.5 for a boss

maps._source: the wiki's 地图补正 by expedition_data_by_map type (1 normal, 2 hard) as [first chapter, bonus]: normal 1-5 0, 6-8 1, 9-10 2, 11 3, 12-14 4; hard 1-3 0, 4-6 1, 7-8 2, 9-10 3, 11-12 4. The later chapters keep the last bonus; event maps get none
